reasons: Previous run used WorldPop R2025A constrained population, which can omit rural and low-density residential cells.
Previous run used only the >=10-population-cell sunshine maximum rather than every positive-population cell.
Previous run used a 90% sunshine population coverage threshold rather than the corrected 99% threshold.
Previous run's altitude exception decision order incorrectly marked low-altitude inhabited samples as incomplete when additional candidate points were intentionally not queried.

corrected_rules.sunshine_hard_exclusion: population-weighted sunshine coverage >=99%; maximum estimated annual sunshine among every positive-population cell <1725 hours
corrected_rules.altitude_exception: any observed inhabited sample <=2000m retains the unit
corrected_rules.altitude_strong_fail: all 10 samples >2000m with unsampled inhabited cells remains pending
